title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
description: <p>You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.</p> <h3><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h3> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.</p> <p>As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.</li> <li>Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.</li> <li>Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.</li> <li>Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.&nbsp;</li> <li>Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.</li> <li>Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.</li> <li>Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.</li> <li>Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.</li> <li>The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.</li> <li>Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.</li> <li>A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.</li> <li>An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.</li> <li>A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.</li> <li>The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.</li> <li>Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.</li> <li>A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.</li> <li>Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.</li> <li>As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What success looks like</strong></h3> <p>Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.</p> <h3><strong>Why join JetBrains?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.</li> <li>Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.</li> <li>Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.</li> <li>Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer. About Us
Canary Technologies is changing the game for hotels with modern software powered by Canary's hospitality-specific AI platform.
 
Canary is utilized by 20,000+ hoteliers in 100+ countries to equip hoteliers with the technology they need to work smarter and wow their guests. Major hotel brands such as Wyndham, Marriott, IHG, Four Seasons, Rosewood, and Best Western trust Canary to deliver results.
 
Canary was named a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, a Most Innovative Company by Fast Company and a HotelTechReport Best Place to Work — and is backed by top Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, F-Prime, Brighton Park Capital and Insight Partners.
 
Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!
 

About the Role

Canary is at the forefront of providing AI-powered technology solutions to the hospitality industry. Our mission is to help hotels modernize operations, enhance guest experiences, and drive business results through intuitive, digital-first products. Our innovative platform is trusted by hotels worldwide for its ability to streamline operations and improve guest satisfaction.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing team and help lead the development of impactful products across key areas of our platform. In this role, you’ll take ownership of complex problem spaces, work closely with cross-functional partners, and drive initiatives that are critical to Canary’s continued growth and customer success.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of high-leverage product areas, such as:

  • Guest communication
  • Digital check-in
  • Payments
  • Upsells
  • And more!

As part of a globally distributed team, you’ll collaborate regularly with colleagues and customers across time zones—so flexibility, asynchronous communication, and strong cross-cultural collaboration skills are essential.

If you are a strong product thinker with at least 5 years of product management experience, and you’re excited to help shape the future of hospitality tech, we’d love to connect.


Responsibilities
  • Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and delivery plans for the Canary platform.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design teams to bring intuitive, scalable, and reliable features to life.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful product launches and strong customer adoption.
  • Conduct in-depth customer research and product analysis to inform prioritization and uncover new opportunities.
  • Translate complex customer and business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Set clear goals and success metrics, and use data to drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Help mentor product managers and contribute to the broader product culture and processes.

    • Qualifications
  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a technology-driven environment.
  • Proven ability to define and ship successful products that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong product intuition and customer empathy—you understand how to solve real problems with elegant, user-focused solutions.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to drive execution in an agile environment.
  • Skilled at making data-informed decisions while remaining grounded in customer feedback.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across time zones within globally distributed teams.
  • Bonus: Experience in hospitality technology, messaging platforms, payments, or AI/ automation is a plus.

    • EU Compensation

    Target cash compensation ranges from €140,000 - €175,000, including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid quarterly.

    This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

    Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.

    We also work hard to ensure Canary is a fun and exciting place to work! Here are some of the additional benefits:
     
    Canary Days:  As a company we want to ensure that the team has time to recharge. Each month we provide company wide days off to ensure there is at least one extended weekend or day off.
     
    Self Improvement Club: We meet each month and share our personal goals for the month. Each individual is provided a budget towards any purchases that help us achieve these goals.
     
    Professional Development Chats: We provide budget to help drive cross functional professional development conversations across the organization.
     
    Travel Reimbursement: Team members are able to visit our offices across New York, San Francisco or Dallas when they choose, and are provided a travel stipend for doing so.  Spend time working with the team in their office, and use the rest of your time exploring a new city!
     
    Personal Travel Reimbursement: If you stay at a hotel that Canary works with, we provide a credit towards your stay.
     
    Canary Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote talent regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other protected characteristic.

Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2> <p>We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in propelling our new business growth in the Mid Market and Enterprise segment, leveraging your expertise to foster and maintain key client relationships. If you are passionate about consultative sales and eager to make a significant impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Product Evangelism:</strong> Champion Fin's product by driving its adoption and growth within the Mid-Market and Enterprise segment.</li> <li><strong>Sales Cycle Management:</strong> Oversee the complete new business sales cycle for Mid-Market/Enterprise customers, from initial outbound to closing deals, utilising a consultative values based sales approach.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Reporting:</strong> Deliver accurate sales forecasts and provide clear visibility on revenue performance.</li> <li><strong>Product Knowledge:</strong> Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date knowledge of our evolving products and sales processes.</li> <li><strong>Tailored Demonstrations:</strong> Develop and present customized product demonstrations to meet specific client needs.</li> <li><strong>Team Development:</strong> Engage in mentoring and development activities within the sales team.</li> <li><strong>Customer Advocacy:</strong> Represent the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders, including Marketing and Product teams.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Sales Expertise:</strong> Minimum of 5+ years of experience as an Account Executive, with at 3+ years in Saas.</li> <li><strong>Track Record:</strong> Proven success in meeting and exceeding sales quotas.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li><strong>Problem Solving:</strong> Strong ability to navigate and solve challenges in a fast-paced environment, handling both inbound and outbound opportunities across various industries and company sizes.</li> <li><strong>Closing Skills:</strong> Demonstrated ability to close net new business in a competitive landscape.</li> <li><strong>Growth Mindset:</strong> Exhibits intellectual curiosity, ambition, and a continuous learning attitude.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits&nbsp;</h2> <p>We are a well treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us!&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing start-up</li> <li>Catered lunch every weekday, plus a fully stocked kitchen</li> <li>Regular compensation reviews - we reward great work!</li> <li>Unlimited access to Claude Code and best-in-class AI tools; experimentation &amp; building is encouraged &amp; celebrated</li> <li>Flexible paid time off policy&nbsp;</li> <li>Healthcare stipend towards private health insurance for you and your partner/spouse</li> <li>MacBooks are our standard, but we also offer Windows for certain roles when needed</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Tech Lead Manager - Lakebase
description: <p>P-1584</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.</p> <p>Lakebase enables teams to deliver applications faster with an optimised database developer experience, integration with the lakehouse, and simplified operations. It provides a managed Postgres transactional layer for application state and workloads that combine operational data, analytics, and AI. You'll join as one of the founding leaders building out both the Lakebase product and our London presence.</p> <p>This is a Tech Lead Manager role: a hands-on technical leader who guides a small team of around five engineers while staying deep in the engineering work. You'll spend the majority of your time hands-on — driving architecture and design, solving the hardest problems in your team's projects, aligning with partner teams on dependencies, and writing code — and the rest leading and growing the engineers around you, who will report directly to you. It's&nbsp; role for a strong senior engineer who wants to lead a team and take on people management without stepping away from the technical work.</p> <p>The team you will lead (one of):</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lakebase Platform Reliability (LPR)</strong> — Constantly evolve Lakebase reliability: cross-functional infrastructure, observability, SLI/SLO definition and measurement, and higher operational efficiency without humans-in-the-loop, for both internal and customer-facing systems, by building AI-powered automation and services.</li> <li><strong>Lakebase Proxy</strong> — Build the heart of the Lakebase data path, the network edge that every customer touches. The proxy handles all client connections and transfers every byte of query traffic, serving every data protocol: Postgres, HTTP, WebSockets, and the Data API. We route and manage large volumes of concurrent connections, solving load balancing, authentication, and data access at high throughput, with a focus on performance, observability, and reliability.</li> <li><strong>Lakebase Storage</strong> — Drive continuous delivery within a team of experts in storage technology, distributed systems, and Rust. We manage the development and rollout of storage services that host millions of customer databases across dozens of regions, partnering with peer engineering teams across Databricks to co-evolve Lakebase services with our global infrastructure, and leading operational excellence in the 24/7 operation of our system.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a small team of 5-6 engineers, owning execution and on-time, high-quality delivery.</li> <li>Stay hands-on: drive architecture and design, and write code on the hardest parts of your team's projects.</li> <li>Set and uphold high technical standards through architecture reviews, testing, and a culture of engineering excellence.</li> <li>Grow the engineers on your team with clear feedback and career development.</li> <li>Align with partner teams on dependencies and unblock cross-cutting projects across the Lakebase stack.</li> <li>Partner with engineering and product leadership to shape and deliver a long-term roadmap.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of engineering experience, including time as a tech lead or senior engineer, driving projects end-to-end.</li> <li>Strong hands-on technical depth: you still design systems and write code, and can go deep on architecture for large-scale distributed services.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale distributed services and the processes around testing, monitoring, and SLAs.</li> <li>People management, or at least tech lead experience, is a must — you're ready to take on direct reports and lead them.</li> <li>Ability to align multiple stakeholders on competing priorities.</li> <li>Able to balance short-term delivery against long-term stability.</li> <li>BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(255, 54, 33);"><a style="color: rgb(255, 54, 33);" href="https://twitter.com/databricks" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://twitter.com/databricks&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1700237575733000&amp;usg=AOvVaw03FL8fJvOD97ytN02f5G2C">Twitter</a>,&nbsp;<a style="color: rgb(255, 54, 33);" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1700237575733000&amp;usg=AOvVaw15dLk3q8VxTfHEgCUg7NSt">LinkedIn</a>&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">and</span>&nbsp;<a style="color: rgb(255, 54, 33);" href="https://www.facebook.com/databricksinc" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.facebook.com/databricksinc&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1700237575733000&amp;usg=AOvVaw39EcncitnlqV72EG2-RqXJ">Facebook</a></span>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. Tech, Solutions Integrations, Marketing Science, Planning, and Activation with a platform for true client and business impact.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Overall Purpose:</strong></p> <p>To lead, shape, and directly influence our lower funnel performance offer to clients – grounded in social and OR programmatic, with influence into the wider portfolio.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibility set</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Performance planning &amp; At Kuoni Tumlare, we design and deliver exceptional travel experiences through a comprehensive portfolio of destination management solutions. The Job:

We are looking for a person with Travel and Tourism industry experience to join our new Business Quality Assurance team and help us elevate the quality of our products to the next level. We are seeking someone who would be keen to learn modern web technologies and software testing skills and is passionate about quality, reliability, and efficiency.

• Validate workflows with a business-focus to confirm the solution meets business needs

• Provide clear and concise demonstrations to stakeholders

• Ensure that the UAT environment, data, and processes accurately reflect production conditions

• Prepare, coordinate, support User Acceptance Testing and manage issues based on business impact

• Actively identify opportunities to optimize testing processes and improve efficiency

• Learn and work with Playwright or Cypress (and other modern automation tools)

• Manage automated tests (UI, API, integration, end-to-end)


• 3+ years of business/UAT QA experience with a strong understanding of business processes.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a quality-first mindset

• Show awareness of the system structure to diagnose issues

• Self-driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of product quality

• Demonstrate agility in learning and applying new technologies.

Nice to Have

• Experience in Tour Operations or Destination Management

• Experience in software testing, ideally in a web-based environment

  • Global Brand: Opportunity to work in an international environment spread across 33 countries and growing.

  • Progression: We reward high performers and look to promote key talent internally

We're here to build better long-term care.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Eucalyptus is now part of Hims &amp; Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.<br><br></p> <h3>Our Growth Story:</h3> <ul> <li>Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets</li> <li>Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS</li> <li>Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.</li> </ul></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Director of Operations</strong> to own the systems, structure, and governance that allow our supply chain and fulfilment operation to scale reliably as we grow into a more complex, multi-brand business under the Hims &amp; Hers umbrella.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership role sitting at the intersection of operations, supply chain, commercial delivery, and cross-functional execution. You will be responsible for making sure the operation works - not just today, but as we transition to the Hims &amp; Hers brand, treat more conditions, and grow order volumes over the next few years.</p> <p>You will report into the VP of Operations Assurance at Hims &amp; Hers, leading a small but growing team.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy &amp; Planning:</strong> Define and own the annual supply chain strategy, OKRs, and volume forecasting, translating growth plans into resource, capex, and headcount.</li> <li><strong>Supply Chain &amp; Procurement:</strong> Manage end-to-end demand and supply planning, pharmaceutical and vendor relationships, and procurement governance across Rx and non-Rx categories.</li> <li><strong>Order Management and Order Life Cycle: </strong>Manage Prescribe to Pharmacy process while executing exceptions and meeting appropriate SLA’s.&nbsp; <strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> <li><strong>Delivery &amp; Patient Experience:</strong> Own courier strategy, carrier SLA management, and the delivery experience function as a retention lever.</li> <li><strong>Cost &amp; COGS:</strong> Own fulfilment cost per order and shipping targets, identifying and delivering initiatives to reduce COGS and wastage across the operation.</li> <li><strong>Fulfilment Engineering &amp; Systems:</strong> Own the roadmap for fulfilment systems (PMR, WMS, ERP) across our pharmacy and warehouse operations, partnering with engineering to deliver and govern them reliably at scale.</li> <li><strong>Inventory Control: </strong>Manage IC related responsibilities including day to day but also month and quarter close while ensuring appropriate accounting and compliance measures to meet accuracy commitments.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional Launches:</strong> Lead supply chain input into new product and brand launches, coordinating across Commercial, Clinical, and Growth as we expand under Hims &amp; Hers.</li> <li><strong>Team &amp; Org Design:</strong> Lead and grow a small team from day one, hiring key roles and building a high-accountability culture as the operation scales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <p>You are an experienced operations leader who thrives in high-growth environments where the pace is fast and the problems are genuinely complex. You know how to build structure without creating bureaucracy, and how to hold a high bar on execution without slowing the business down.</p> <p>You are as comfortable in the weeds of a supply chain model or a fulfilment systems conversation as you are presenting a strategy to senior stakeholders. You are commercially sharp, operationally rigorous, and a natural cross-functional partner.</p> <p>You are excited by the challenge of scaling an operation that is already moving quickly - bringing the systems, governance, and team capability needed to support a more complex, multi-brand business as Eucalyptus grows within the Hims &amp; Hers portfolio.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>8–12 years of experience</strong> in supply chain, operations, or a related function, with at least 3–4 years in a director or head-of level role with a team behind you</li> <li>Proven track record of owning end-to-end supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale - ideally in a high-growth, high-volume environment (e.g. e-commerce, health, consumer goods, mobility)</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build and manage supplier and vendor relationships across complex, multi-category supply chains</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen - able to own COGS targets, model cost initiatives, and communicate financial impact clearly</li> <li>Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to define and deliver fulfilment system requirements &amp; transformations (e.g. WMS, ERP, order management)</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional product and category launches from an operations perspective</li> <li>Strong people leadership skills - able to hire, develop, and performance manage a growing team</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management - confident presenting to exec and SLT-level audiences and partnering across commercial, clinical, and finance functions</li> <li>Based in London, with willingness to travel to Birmingham &amp; Enfield on a regular basis</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why join Eucalyptus?</strong></h3> <p>Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (<a href="https://pilot.com.au/">Pilot,</a>&nbsp;<a href="http://www.kinfertility.com.au/">Kin</a>,&nbsp;<a href="http://skin.software/">Software</a>, <a href="https://www.compound.co/">Compound</a>) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.</p> <p><strong>Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>What’s next</strong> - Our goal for the next three years is to support <strong>1 million patients globally</strong> to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Build something world-changing</strong> - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.</li> <li><strong>Make real impact</strong> - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate your growth</strong> - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.</li> <li><strong>Join a motivated team</strong> - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.</li> </ul> <h3>What’s ahead in the UK</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Invest in your growth</strong> – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave</li> <li><strong>Work flexibly</strong> – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration</li> <li><strong>Support your well-being</strong> – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you</li> <li><strong>Take time off</strong> – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year</li> <li><strong>Join a connected team</strong> – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. title: Director of Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure&nbsp;</strong>for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.<br><br>Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.<br><br>Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.<br><br><strong>Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.</strong><br><br><strong>Our Team Members:</strong></p> <p>We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!<br><br>We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.</p></div><p><strong>Your Role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Head of Data to lead Alpaca’s ~15-person data department across Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science. You will own the data strategy, the team’s execution, and the department’s roadmap.</p> <p>The Data department serves every function at Alpaca: it powers partner invoicing and revenue attribution, provides the analytical foundation for sales, product, and compliance, and operates the data platform that processes hundreds of millions of events daily. You will manage three team leads, balancing operational delivery (invoicing, embedded analytics, regulatory reporting) with strategic bets (self-service warehouse, AI-powered analytics, enterprise search).</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. You will set direction for the team while staying close enough to the technical details to make architecture decisions, unblock your leads, and represent data’s capabilities to the executive team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>Things You Get To Do:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead and develop three sub-teams: Platform Engineering &amp; ETL, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science &amp; Analytics. Manage leads, set priorities, and ensure delivery.</li> <li>Own the Data Lakehouse architecture: Trino, Iceberg/GCS, Airflow, Airbyte, Redpanda CDC, dbt. Make build-vs-buy decisions on tooling.</li> <li>Drive partner invoicing accuracy and evolution: ensure invoicing logic is versioned, reproducible, and scales with new pricing mechanisms and product launches.</li> <li>Deliver embedded analytics: expose warehouse data to partners via BrokerDash, SSR pipelines, and API-based reporting. Own row-level security and entitlements.</li> <li>Support product launches with data change management: coordinate data impact analysis for new products (fixed income, global stocks, perps, 24/5 trading) across downstream datasets, dashboards, and reverse ETL.</li> <li>Accelerate self-service: move the organization toward self-serve analytics via semantic layers, data catalogues, and conversational BI so the data team can shift from ad-hoc queries to strategic projects.</li> <li>Guide AI/ML enablement: oversee enterprise AI search, agent-based workflow automation, and LLM-powered analytics. Help balance vendor solutions with in-house development.</li> <li>Collaborate with Finance, Sales, Product, Compliance, and Customer Success to translate business needs into data products.</li> <li>Manage infrastructure costs: keep data + cloud cost ratio under target as AUC grows.</li> <li>Operate production systems: own on-call processes, incident response, and SLOs for data freshness, accuracy, and availability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Must-Haves):</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in data engineering or analytics, including 3+ years managing data teams (leads + ICs).</li> <li>Deep experience with modern data stack: dbt, Trino/Presto or equivalent query engines, Apache Iceberg or similar table formats, cloud object storage.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT patterns at scale: CDC (Debezium/Kafka), batch (Airflow/dbt), streaming, and reverse ETL.</li> <li>Track record of building self-service analytics capabilities for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with financial data: trading, invoicing, revenue attribution, or regulatory reporting in fintech or financial services.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and SQL. Comfortable reading code, reviewing PRs, and making architecture decisions.</li> <li>Experience managing distributed/remote teams across multiple time zones.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management: you can translate between executive priorities and engineering execution.</li> <li>Experience with GCP (GKE, GCS, BigQuery migration), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with brokerage or broker-dealer operations (clearing, settlement, market making, reconciliation).</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM/AI tooling: MCP, vector databases, enterprise search, conversational BI (WrenAI, Cube).</li> <li>Background in compliance analytics (AML/Actimize, KYC, margin calls).</li> <li>Exposure to open-source data catalogues (OpenMetadata, Collate) and data quality frameworks.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>How We Take Care of You:</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive Salary &amp; Stock Options</span></li> <li style="text-align: justify;">Health Benefits</li> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card</span></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.<br></span></em></p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><a href="https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/AlpacaRecruitmentPrivacyPolicy.pdf"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recruitment Privacy Policy</span></em></a></span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Account Director
raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does an Account Director do at WPP Production?

The role

Our Account Director (AD) are knowledgeable and trusted Client leads.  Accountable for end-to-end project delivery, management of client and agency relationships, they lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver. Responsible for operational discipline, delivery, resource optimisation and profitability management across Clients and projects. You are the key point person for the projects you are leading and are responsible for delivering on time, on specification and on budget.

You possess problem-solving skills, have a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. Highly organised and accountable, you build trusting Client and team relationships, collaborate across multi-disciplined teams and draw on the expertise of Hogarth's resources and capabilities. You are ensure we execute flawlessly.

Key areas of responsibility

Communication

  • Responsible for managing the day to day client relationship with a focus on Client delivery
  • Oversee the on-time delivery of projects and ensure the smooth delivery and swift resolution of issues to maintain client confidence in WPP capabilities to deliver
  • The key day-to-day Client Delivery contact with clients, agencies and all associated WPP Production teams
  • Understanding of client's needs to deliver high satisfaction levels and share feedback with wider team and escalate any delivery concerns to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Act as the primary client contact for project delivery, structuring regular status and communications with clients, defining scope and approach, setting and managing expectations and deliverables and troubleshooting issues as they arise
  • Work with client brands and agencies to ensure a clear understanding of the production brief, deliverables and timeline for each project and relay those details to other members of the team as necessary
  • Accountable for ensuring all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables

Collaboration

  • Partner with Client Services, Production and Finance to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation and a superior result
  • Develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness, trust, communication, collaboration, productivity, diversity, engagement and ensure the team feel personal accountability for deliverables and projects
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration skills with internal agency teams and key external partners to ensure quality and adherence to production guidelines for key deliverables

Process

  • Manage medium to complex projects independently and with a team, from initiation through to completion
  • Work collaboratively with all internal team members to facilitate the process of developing effective strategies and briefs that lead to great work
  • Understand and anticipate client needs, taking them into account when framing and making delivery decisions
  • Possess an understanding of project and client management techniques and bring process innovation to how we manage our engagements
  • Manage client objectives, budget, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicate changes/direction to team members
  • Keep projects on track through clear team status, task lists, timing schedules, risk register, trackers, status and contact reports
  • Participate actively and knowledgeably articulate status internally and during client interactions
  • Leverage our on-site, onshore, offshore network to deliver great work in the most efficient and effective way
  • Identify improvements to existing workflow and processes
  • Identify potential project risks and develop contingency plans and if needed, escalate to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Review team structure and resources on an ongoing basis to ensure client is serviced appropriately
  • Ensure the highest quality is always delivered to clients

Leadership

  • Create a culture of fresh-thinking, collaboration, respect, equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on learning, development and growth
  • Contribute to WPP Productions culture by exhibiting ownership, professionalism, passion and leading by example
  • Take ownership and find solutions, whilst supporting the wider team by removing any barriers to success
  • Retain the best talent

Financials

  • Demonstrate strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen
  • Own project budgets and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
  • Manage POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
  • Manage financial aspects of assigned accounts including development of SOW and change orders, estimates, profitability analysis, and utilisation, working with Finance where appropriate
  • Responsible for monthly billing and tracking of all production budgets
  • Ensure a thorough understanding of commercial arrangements, and SLA's across assigned accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the broader team
  • Protect margins
  • Proactively seek and identify new revenue opportunities across your clients

Requirements

  • Project / Client management related experience within an interactive or integrated agency, with a good understanding of marketing and production implementation processes across all key channels, including digital, video, content, social etc
  • Good understanding of production and the creative development process, content production, technology, quality assurance testing and marketing methodologies
  • Ability to manage complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget
  • Experience of building solid client relationships
  • A professional, calm, approachable demeanour, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and relationships cross functionally
  • An appreciation for how great work gets done and a commitment to ensuring flawless execution and delivery
  • Proven ability to collaborate with dynamic cross-functional teams to deliver on projects
  • Demonstrates an ability to solve problems with the solution that works for all stakeholders without compromising the quality of the deliverables or the project
  • Must be commercially astute able to build scopes, create budgets and track profitability
  • Proven negotiation skills
  • Strong client relationship skills including presenting to clients and the ability to think on your feet
  • Strong written/oral communication skills
  • Experience of working with offshore teams a plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, wireframing/workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Smartsheet, Trello, Miro etc

#LI-PS1

#LI-Hybrid

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h3 id="Role" data-local-id="10b43cf52313" data-renderer-start-pos="1">Role</h3> <p data-renderer-start-pos="7" data-local-id="28b3793b9fd3">As a Technical Project Manager in Token Factory, your primary focus will be coordinating complex cross-functional projects, including new region launches, engineering quality and platform-wide improvement projects, and the end-to-end delivery pipeline for new AI models. time, and without unnecessary operational overhead.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="528" data-local-id="1ddd78e1c262">Your responsibilities will include:</p> <ul class="ak-ul" and production delivery, from infrastructure readiness to successful customer availability.</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="842" data-local-id="e1aa7ee297ff">Building and maintaining title: Senior/ACD Creative Team
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><p><strong>Senior/ ACD&nbsp;Creative Team&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>*please note, we are looking for an established creative pair, not single candidates at this time!*</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW43933221 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW43933221 BCX8">Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior/ACD Creative Team<strong> </strong></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW43933221 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW43933221 BCX8">to</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW43933221 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW43933221 BCX8"> join our growing 21GRAMS EMEA team!</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW43933221 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Creative work is at the heart of how&nbsp;21GRAMS&nbsp;deliver&nbsp;effective&nbsp;campaigns for our&nbsp;clients.&nbsp;Behaviour changing ideas that drive the healthcare industry forward are what&nbsp;we’re&nbsp;known for, and&nbsp;what’s&nbsp;driving our growth in the Global team, working out of London.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Senior/ACD Team, you’ll have experience of creating, producing and implementing global campaigns for our clients. You’ll be able to find the emotion in the creative brief and create work that stands out from the rest. You’ll know how to develop big ideas that can be localised around the world. And sell them to senior clients. You’ll also be keen to craft them and work with the best people to bring them to life. We love creative ideas, and they deserve to be loved during the production process.&nbsp;</p> <p>With recent pitch wins, we need a team who can&nbsp;work with our teams to answer briefs big and small, across a range of clients and therapy areas.&nbsp;&nbsp;You’re&nbsp;ready to move up, manage teams and&nbsp;make a difference.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a senior role, reporting into the Global Executive Creative Directors.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role &amp; Responsibilities</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Create&nbsp;and execute&nbsp;creative concepts across a range of media&nbsp;</li> <li>Take responsibility for&nbsp;managing&nbsp;accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentor the teams under you&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop a&nbsp;productive and rewarding relationship with your clients&nbsp;</li> <li>Working closely with the Strategy team to ensure work is based on the best insights and on brief&nbsp;</li> <li>Work collaboratively with&nbsp;the&nbsp;creative&nbsp;team -&nbsp;Designers, Art Directors, Copywriters, and the wider&nbsp;agency&nbsp;team to bring ideas to life&nbsp;</li> <li>Manage assigned tasks within timelines and project requirements&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What are we looking for in you?</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in advertising and the book that goes with it (that means a portfolio demonstrating big ideas and smart thinking for real clients!)</li> <li>Healthcare experience is preferable</li> <li>A curiosity for ideas and how design can help express the thinking behind them&nbsp;</li> <li>You’re&nbsp;proactive and expect that of your team&nbsp;</li> <li>Good communication&nbsp;skills and openness to collaboration&nbsp;</li> <li>A track record of developing relationships with clients.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>An awareness of AI and emerging creative tools, with the perspective that meaning comes from thinking, making, and crafting, not generating. You are interested in where design is going, but believe the best way to learn is to make things, break them, and make them better&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work®&nbsp;certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile&nbsp;<u><a href="https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2Fcertified-company%2F7038366&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cclehmar%40realchemistry.com%7C1f18aaed4326491b3efc08ddd690f025%7C6fa5bfc4f95843f8bb395d382689654b%7C0%7C0%7C638902640185888156%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=pwvaCn37QXkjVQ0p6u92Oz4FA4j5NQZoNJL0ffy01qs%3D&amp;reserved=0">here</a>.</u></p> <p>We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support&nbsp;and&nbsp;access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.&nbsp;&nbsp;Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at:&nbsp;<a href="https://www.realchemistrybenefits.com">www.realchemistrybenefits.com</a>.</p> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey.&nbsp;For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients.
